newsitem.title: DUBAI: KPC and India Oil Corp agree oil product terms.
newsitem.headline: KPC and India Oil Corp agree oil product terms.

text.p: Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) and Indian Oil Corp (IOC) have agreed price and volume terms for high speed diesel and superior kerosene delivered between April 1996 and March 1997, Gulf traders said on Thursday.

Price terms had been set at slightly firmer than a 40 cents premium to quotes fob Kuwait for one percent sulphur gas oil material, with a proviso that prices would be re-examined if IOC chose to lift 0.5 percent or 0.25 percent grades, traders said.
Total crude and product supplies under the agreement would reach an estimated 7.5 million tonnes, in line with previous contract volumes, traders in the region said.
IOC imported about 900,000 tonnes of diesel and 1.08 million tonnes of kerosene from KPC in its 1995/96 term deal.
Prices are retroactive to April and run until March.
Contract negotiations from supplies which began in April this year had been delayed because of Indian elections in May and the subsequent changes in government.
KPC officials were not immediately available for comment.
KPC is also a regular supplier into IOC's middle distillate spot tenders.
